# fct_site_click_events

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_site_click_events` · dbt area: `growth`

Click and interaction events on foratravel.com, filtered from the full GA4 event stream to exclude page view, session, and other non-click tracking events. Each row is one click event. Sourced from Google Analytics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `device_category` | The device category (mobile, desktop) at the time of the click >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_at` | The timestamp of the click event. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_key` | A unique identifier / surrogate key created for the event. Can be null for anonymized events. >> SOURCE - Calculated from GA data data_tests: - unique |
| `event_name` | The name of the click/interaction event, such as join__hero_cta_click >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path` | The page path where the click event occurred >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `session_key` | The session the click event occurred in >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `user_pseudo_id` | The unique identifier of the user as identified by Google Analytics >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
